verify-driver-vendor-linkage.mjs: baselined 2026-09-05 SEED/DRIVERS-ARE-VENDORS historical backfill (owner task) — asserts live (DATABASE_URL half) 0 settlement-active USMCA drivers without a live vendor_type='Driver' row and 0 active driver-linked vendors still typed 'Other'; static half re-locks the ensure-driver-vendor.shared.ts create path (same assertion as verify-driver-vendor-type-not-other.mjs, kept independent per-guard rather than cross-imported). Applied via scripts/backfill-driver-vendor-linkage.ts through the real ensure-drivers/PATCH routes (no raw INSERT): 94 of 97 mis-typed 'Other' rows re-typed to 'Driver' live-verified (driver_vendor_control=97, PASS); the remaining 3 are deactivated/archived vendor rows the PATCH route correctly excludes from generic field updates (void-not-delete — not a defect). Settlement-active is defined as carrying real financial substance (nonzero gross/net/deductions/reimbursements, a posted_at, or an accounting_bill_id) specifically to exclude 2 newly-discovered $0.00 open/unposted duplicate mdata.drivers records (HUGO GAYTAN 3445cf68, GENARO GUERRERO CHAVEZ 6edcb351) — each shadows a sibling driver_id that already carries the correct 'Driver' vendor; minting a second vendor would collide on mdata.vendors' name-uniqueness constraint by design and fork a second real-money payee for one physical person. Boarded separately (docs/bus/OUTBOX-CC-3.md) as its own duplicate-driver-record defect, NOT fixed by this guard/backfill — if either drafted settlement ever carries real money the guard goes RED, which is the correct signal. Linkage part (c) (settlement bills/expenses rolling up to the driver-vendor) needed no new code: apps/backend/src/accounting/driver-vendor-link.service.ts already resolves the canonical mdata.vendors.driver_id link with no vendor_type filter, so once the vendor row exists/is-typed correctly the existing settlement-posting pipeline picks it up. Same CC-3 lane-band constraint as verify-drv03-server-side-dqf-hard-block-gate.mjs above; runs via verify-static.mjs's own scripts/verify-*.mjs glob auto-discovery plus its own --selftest; wire into a claimed verify-step once a claim PR lands on main
